subject: windrunner_focusfire
description_zh: 风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加%bonus_attack_speed%，但是攻击力降低。不过次级物品效果的额外伤害不会降低。
description_en: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
notes_zh: 下达停在原地的指令会暂停风行者的攻击。
风行者在攻击时可以移动。

subject: zuus_arc_lightning
description_zh: 释放一道会跳跃穿越附近敌人的闪电，并造成伤害。
description_en: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.

subject: zuus_lightning_bolt
description_zh: 召唤一道闪电打击一个敌方单位，造成伤害及短暂眩晕。施放后，雷击在目标周围%sight_radius_night%范围内提供空中视野和真实视域。本技能可以对地施放，将会自动作用于%spread_aoe%范围内最近的敌方英雄上。
description_en: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a %sight_radius_night% radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in %spread_aoe% range.
notes_zh: 该技能可以打断持续施法类技能和物品。

subject: kunkka_tidebringer
description_zh: 昆卡的传奇之剑使他的下一次攻击附加额外的攻击力并在前方造成大范围的分裂攻击伤害。
description_en: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.

subject: kunkka_x_marks_the_spot
description_zh: 对友方或敌方英雄使用，用 X 标记他们当前位置，数秒后将他们送回 X 标记处。在技能持续时间内，昆卡可以手动触发送回。对友方英雄使用后持续时间加倍。
description_en: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.

subject: lina_laguna_blade
description_zh: 对单个敌方单位射出闪电，造成大量伤害。
description_en: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
notes_zh: 神灭斩在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。

shard.zh: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。
shard.en: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.

subject: lich_frost_nova
description_zh: 破坏性的寒霜在目标敌方单位身上爆发，造成范围伤害并降低范围内敌人的移动和攻击速度，持续%abilityduration%秒。主要目标所受伤害最高。
description_en: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.

subject: lich_sinister_gaze
description_zh: 持续施法 - 使一个敌方单位着魔，缓慢走到巫妖与其之间的一点，并吸取其当前魔法值的一定百分比。
description_en: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.

scepter.zh: 阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域%aoe_scepter%范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。
scepter.en: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

subject: lich_chain_frost
description_zh: 释放一个在敌人间弹跳至多%jumps%次的霜冻之球，每次击中敌人后都会造成伤害和减速效果。每次弹跳后会提升后续的伤害。连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
description_en: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
notes_zh: 连环霜冻无法被躲避。
连环霜冻的移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
连环霜冻不会弹跳到墓碑召唤的僵尸身上。

subject: lion_voodoo
description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，受害者无法使用所有特殊能力。
description_en: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
notes_zh: 即刻摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

subject: lion_mana_drain
description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导魔法能量，持续吸取魔法并减缓敌人的移动速度。如果敌人没有魔法剩余，减速效果提升%movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%。可以对友军施放，给予他们%ally_pct%%%魔法和移动速度。
description_en: CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.  Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
notes_zh: 阻止英雄进入隐身状态。

shard.zh: 法力吸取可以作用最多%shard_bonus_targets%个额外敌人，并且断裂距离增加。持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性。
shard.en: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.

subject: lion_finger_of_death
description_zh: 撕裂一个敌方单位，将其折磨得死去活来，并造成巨大伤害。使用死亡之指后，莱恩的手臂增强了力量，使他可以发动带有分裂效果的近战攻击，攻击距离为%punch_attack_range%，并拥有移动速度加成。每次技能或重拳击杀英雄后都会分别使技能和重拳永久获得额外伤害和攻击力。技能设为（右键点击技能栏图标）后可以禁用近战攻击。
description_en: Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with %punch_attack_range% range with bonus movement speed.Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills. The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
notes_zh: 死亡一指在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
只有在敌方英雄受到死亡之指作用后%grace_period%秒内死亡才会使死亡之指额外提升伤害。

scepter.zh: 死亡之指的初始施法获得范围型伤害，并且后续的近战攻击提升持续时间和分裂伤害。
scepter.en: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.

subject: shadow_shaman_ether_shock
description_zh: 利用虚空能量制造出分叉的闪电，打击多个敌方单位。
description_en: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
notes_zh: 最远可以伤害1000距离外的次级单位。

subject: shadow_shaman_voodoo
description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，使其无法攻击和使用技能。
description_en: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
notes_zh: 立即摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

subject: shadow_shaman_shackles
description_zh: 持续施法 - 使用魔法绑住一个敌方单位，使其无法攻击和移动，同时持续吸取他们的生命能量。
description_en: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.

scepter.zh: 提升施法距离。被绑住的单位每%scepter_shock_interval%秒会释放一次辐射状的苍穹震击，作用于%scepter_shock_radius%范围内其他所有单位，造成伤害的数值为%scepter_shock_pct%%%苍穹震击普通伤害。另外还能使枷锁可以对暗影萨满附近%ally_break_range%范围内的友军和群蛇守卫施放。友方单位不会被控制。
scepter.en: Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.

subject: slardar_amplify_damage
description_zh: 削弱敌人的护甲，加深他受到的物理伤害，同时提供目标的真实视域，显示隐身单位。敌方单位将在身后留下水迹。
description_en: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.

subject: tidehunter_gush
description_zh: 召唤一股巨浪攻击一个敌方单位，减速并削弱护甲。
description_en: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.

scepter.zh: 巨浪变成点地施放的波形技能，可以作用于直线上的单位。降低冷却时间。
scepter.en: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.

subject: tidehunter_dead_in_the_water
description_zh: 潮汐猎人将一只重锚栓到一名敌方英雄身上。被栓到锚上的英雄处于被束缚状态。尝试移动到距离巨锚%chain_length%距离外会导致英雄的移动速度降低至%max_movement_speed%，而且会一直拽着长锚。巨锚承受%attacks_to_destroy%次英雄攻击后会被摧毁。
description_en: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with %attacks_to_destroy% hero attacks.

subject: witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask
description_zh: 抛出一个装满麻痹粉末的药剂，在敌方单位之间弹跳，眩晕击中的敌人并造成伤害。每次弹跳都会提升伤害。
description_en: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
notes_zh: 目标可以受到多次作用，只要附近有其他单位可以进行弹跳。

subject: riki_blink_strike
description_zh: 传送到目标背后，如果是敌人对其造成%slow_pct_tooltip%%%短暂减速，并发动一次拥有额外伤害的攻击。
description_en: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.

subject: enigma_malefice
description_zh: 将谜团的力量集中于一个目标，使它受到多次伤害并反复被眩晕。每%tick_rate%秒眩晕一次。
description_en: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every %tick_rate% seconds.

shard.zh: 憎恶的眩晕时间增加%shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%秒，并且每次眩晕都会在目标身旁产生一个虚灵体。这些虚灵体不会再次分裂。
shard.en: Increases Malefice stun duration by %shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.

subject: tinker_laser
description_zh: 发射强烈的能量光束，对目标造成伤害和致盲。被致盲的单位，所有物理攻击都会落空。
description_en: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.

scepter.zh: 修补匠的激光升级成缩小射线，使主目标的模型大小、当前生命值和最大生命值减少%scepter_reduction_pct%%%（可以叠加）。
scepter.en: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by %scepter_reduction_pct%%% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.

subject: tinker_warp_grenade
description_zh: 向一个敌人扔出一枚光弹，造成伤害，将其向远离修补匠的方向传送并且缠绕，同时降低施法和攻击距离，持续%debuff_duration%秒。目标距离修补匠越近，传送距离越大。
description_en: Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for %debuff_duration% seconds.The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
notes_zh: 最大传送距离为%warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%%折跃耀光施法距离，在最大施法距离时降至0。

subject: sniper_assassinate
description_zh: 狙击手锁定一个目标敌方单位，经过短时间瞄准后射出一发毁灭性的子弹，从远距离对目标造成狙击手的攻击伤害 + 额外伤害，并且短暂眩晕目标。每当狙击手击杀敌方英雄，暗杀的冷却时间就会重置。
description_en: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
notes_zh: 准星效果只对队友可见。
隐身不能躲避该技能弹道。

scepter.zh: 暗杀释放得更快，并且敌方目标的眩晕时间更久。
scepter.en: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.

subject: necrolyte_death_seeker
description_zh: 瘟疫法师变成一个大死亡脉冲，向目标单位的地点移动。到达该地点后，死亡脉冲会扩散至附近敌人和友军。
description_en: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术反弹。
